packageRules.description: Keep github-actions commits typed ci so release-please does not cut a release for them.
Keep gomod commits typed deps so release-please does not cut a release for them.
Group stretchr/testify updates into their own PR, separate from the other Go modules.
Group HashiCorp module updates into their own PR, separate from the other Go modules.
Keep consul/api on v1. The api/v2.0.0 tag is an older snapshot than current v1 releases, and upstream still publishes on the v1 module path.
